announcement.msg_id: ARA 4.6.0: tampilan RANA, Studio dengan seleksi dan simpan versi, Deck proyek/pustaka, serta Autopilot dengan jangkar acuan. Satu installer untuk semua: ARA- = Umum, ARO- = Office; masa coba mendapat bonus Deck. Pengguna Office: tutup ARA lama, pasang installer yang sama. Unduh di github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
announcement.msg_en: ARA 4.6.0: RANA interface, Studio selection and saved versions, Deck projects/image library, and reference anchors for Autopilot. One installer: ARA- = General, ARO- = Office; trial includes bonus Deck access. Office users: close the old ARA app and install the same installer. Download at github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
